chunks.text: OISD inspection clause 4.2: corroded pipe sections with pitting depth over 1.5mm or wall loss over 12.5% shall be flagged for NDT ultrasonic thickness gauging within 7 days.
SOP-U2-118: shift engineer must raise a preliminary inspection note with photo evidence, measurement, and location tag before any shutdown recommendation.
Ultrasonic grid: take 8-point readings around circumference at the corroded band; record minimum thickness and flag OCR/low-confidence measurements for human re-check.
